digest.component_or_area: janitor plan-review derisk (RP-02 through RP-06); BindingStore recovery; outbound Jira lifecycle; config composition; CLI registry; plan-review kernel
propositions: Recovered 2026-08-16 RP-02 through RP-06 approvals require evidence-backed decision-ready briefs preserving architectural intent and resolving implementation-critical ambiguities before becoming implementation stories.

RP-02 owns ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary; durable tombstone is the retirement intent; recovery removes live forward/reverse pair only when tombstone and identity exactly agree; repeat is a no-op; ambiguity aborts.

RP-03 establishes singular retry ownership: 3 physical wire invocations maximum, 15 seconds cumulative sleep, exponential fallback with jitter, Retry-After as lower bound with deferral, scoped finite-pass fuse at 3 consecutive exhausted outcomes across >=2 tickets, one observe/replan cycle, and commit_unknown for uncertain writes.

RP-04 enforces explicit CLI > environment > project > user > default configuration precedence, per-operation snapshot capture, separate secret/provider boundary, fail-closed malformed-config behavior, and removal of Cloud adapter-local fallback.
RP-05 resolves lazy CLI registry/capability boundary and defers choice on normalizing 21 advanced verbs to side-effect-free help (recommended) versus preserving two-family help policy.

RP-06 implements effective applicability reversal (activated project criteria are evaluated against policy rather than always included), effective built-in/project-DET routing, authored explicit budget enforcement, and defers parity-first versus normalization-first failure-projection choice.
